name: layout
description: AppShell, AppHeader, AppNav, PageHeader, primitives, InstallButton, ThemeToggle, theme.css
postInstall: Set the color accent: edit the `--accent-h` value in theme.css
Pick an accent hue from the table in docs/specs/04-layout-system.md — keep it 25° away from the reserved semantic hues (25 danger, 80 warning, 150 success, 230 info) and from every other app
Prevent theme flash: add `<script src="/theme-init.js"></script>` to <head> in index.html, before your stylesheet
If the app persists the theme somewhere other than localStorage["theme"], adapt public/theme-init.js to read it
